text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer states the 1,020 PS Plaid accelerates extremely hard and keeps pulling beyond 200 km/h. Reviewer states the facelift's revised suspension filters bumps and expansion joints more cleanly and the car stays calm at high speed. Reviewer states the steering is precise but offers limited feedback. Reviewer states the optional yoke (EUR 1,000) is hard to handle when parking or turning in town. Reviewer sees indicator buttons on the steering wheel, fitted with either wheel, as a weakness. Reviewer states material and build quality meet luxury-car expectations and nothing rattles, and tells BMW, Mercedes, Audi and Porsche to take note. Reviewer misses genuine leather and wood trim. Reviewer wants a higher rear seating position for better rear legroom. Reviewer likes the combination of driver display and central touchscreen, which makes the car feel more like a traditional automobile. Reviewer states the low-mounted rear display is poorly placed for long-term use. Reviewer states the camera-based Autopilot made frequent wrong decisions in the test, leaving him hesitant to use self-driving functions. Reviewer calls the 250 kW DC peak solid but no longer ultra-fast compared with rivals. Reviewer highlights lifetime free Supercharging included with the car. Reviewer states the cabin is near silent up to 130 km/h, with wind noise rising only slightly above that. Reviewer calls the price-to-performance ratio almost a bargain at EUR 119,990. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «kommt runter von eurem hohen Ross»
